def manhattan_dist(p1, p2):
    return abs(p1[0] - p2[0]) + abs(p1[1] - p2[1])

def apply_heuristic(grid):
    rows = len(grid)
    cols = len(grid[0])
    
    pos_2s = [(r, c) for r in range(rows) for c in range(cols) if grid[r][c] == 2]

        best_d, best_t2 = float('inf'), None
        for tp in pos_2s:
            d = manhattan_dist(p, tp)
            if d < best_d:
                best_d, best_t2 = d, tp
